# Upstream snapshot

This directory vendors the Chrome extension from `totec448-spec/chat-on-steroids` as the starting point for WebHarness's future ChatGPT worker adapter.

- Upstream repository: `https://github.com/totec448-spec/chat-on-steroids`
- Upstream commit: `9e27c0fafc20bf2c81509844d5f92868678b4168`
- Upstream extension version: `2.0.2`
- Vendored path upstream: `extension/`
- License: MIT; see `LICENSE` in this directory.

The snapshot is intentionally copied unchanged apart from this provenance file and the colocated upstream license. The post-stabilization Agents implementation plan owns any WebHarness-specific adaptation. Do not silently replace this snapshot with a newer upstream revision; review upstream changes and record a new pinned commit when intentionally refreshing it.
